Catalog.note: All six columns visible inside the card width — Model with description subtitle, provider, effort chips with the default chip filled, mode pills, Fast mode badges, and the compact Switch in Enabled. Disabled row shows the opacity-55 treatment.

SparseRows.note: Probe-only rows render the em-dash fallbacks in Thinking/Modes/Fast mode and the mono id subtitle when it differs from the display name. Exactly the sparse case the component documents.

ModeOverflow.note: MAX_VISIBLE_MODES overflow renders as +2 / +1 pills next to the first three modes; a real axis the other cells do not cover, and the Enabled column still fits.

ReadOnlyToggles.note: toggleDisabled rows render the Switch in its disabled state, and the second row combines disabled toggle with enabled=false so both the dimmed row and the read-only control read clearly.
